issue.title: Improve clicking with modifier(s)

labels.name: pkg/driver
labels.description: This is due to an issue in the packages/driver directory

repository.name: cypress
repository.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

issue.body:
The current experience issuing a ctrl-click , cmd-click, etc could use some improvement. 

First, add a section to the `cy.click` doc concerning modifiers, with an example or two. 

Second, consider updating the `cy.click` command to accept modifiers directly instead of needing `cy.type` command first. 

Currently you need this to ctrl-click:

```javascript
cy.get('body').type('{ctrl}', { release: false })
cy.get('#some-el').click()
```

Something like this would be a lot better:

```javascript
cy.get('#some-el').click({ ctrlKey: true })
```

fix #2613
- [x] allow typing minus(`-`) sign into number field if entire field is selected
fix #4767 
- [x] fire input event when {enter} inserts newline
fix #3405
- [x] don't input text when non-shift modifier is pressed
fix #5424
- [x] fire 'code' property on keyboard events
fix #3722


- [x] ~use KeyboardEvent constructor instead of Event from app frame~ _forcing certain property values on the event during and after construction is not stable (does not work in chrome 63)_
- [x] use host contenteditable as focusable element when targeting element inside contenteditable (should help with rich text editors)
- [x] remove need to intercept `select` command and keep cypress cursor state on form elements
